title: refactor(ui)!: retire `@object-ui/plugin-ai` and its three node types
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9AuWjKnBuqeFPqZDMi1DQhC)_

Part of #25921 (the plugin-ai item only; the card's other items stay open).
Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Blocked-by: #26220

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：删除没有任何加载者的 `@object-ui/plugin-ai` 包；十个语言包删掉它的 `ai.*` 文案块；`@object-ui/types` 里它的类型/zod 镜像改为 `@deprecated` 的 `never` 墓碑，三个节点类型（`ai-form-assist` / `ai-recommendations` / `nl-query`）改为按名拒收并给出处方。
- 为什么改：执行 #25921 的裁决 A（6398569691）。console 既不急加载也不懒加载它，工作区里没有任何导入者，发布着却从未被渲染。
- 风险与回滚：npm 外部使用者未实测（changeset 的 BREAKING 说明覆盖）；回滚即 revert 本 PR。18.2.0 已发版，`@object-ui/plugin-ai@18.2.0` 是它最后一个发布版本。唯一的红是 ADR-0087 门禁：整包删除时 HEAD 上没有这个包，D9 没覆盖这种情况，处理方式待维护者决定（补 D9 条款，或本 PR 改用 `registered`）。
- 先看：`ui/packages/types/src/zod/ai.zod.ts`（拒收 arm 与 never 墓碑）、`.changeset/25921-retire-plugin-ai.md`（处方与 ADR-0087 标记）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/types/src/__tests__/plugin-ai-retired-25921.test.ts`，预期 17 条全绿：三个旧节点各自被按名拒收、提到 plugin-ai。
- 需要你做的：在席位卡片上选 ADR-0087 整包删除的处理方式（A 补 D9 条款 / B 改 `registered`）。

## What changes

- **Package deleted.** `ui/packages/plugin-ai/**` (736 LOC of source plus its tests), its `pnpm-lock.yaml` importer and its `ui/vitest.config.mts` alias.
- **Release group.** Its entry leaves the fixed group in `.changeset/config.json` (`check-changeset-fixed`: 109 public + 1 private member in sync). The 18.2 Version PR (#25640) consumed the pending `25831` changeset, so no pending changeset is edited any more.
- **Locale packs.** The `ai.*` block (`ai.nlQuery.*`, `ai.formAssist.*`, `ai.recommendations.*`) is deleted from all ten packs, with its comment in `en.ts`. No other reader of those keys exists (repo-wide grep: 0 hits outside the packs).
- **Types tombstones (ruling A).** `ui/packages/types/src/ai.ts` keeps its nine exported names as `@deprecated` `never` aliases with the remedy, and `AnySchema` loses the three node members. In `zod/ai.zod.ts` the three arms become `retiredNodeType()` refusal arms (`RetiredAIFormAssistNodeSchema`, `RetiredAIRecommendationsNodeSchema`, `RetiredNLQueryNodeSchema`), listed in `AnyComponentSchema` and not exported from the barrel, the shape of the `cloud:plan-status` and `html` retirements. The eight published zod names (`AIFormAssistSchema` and the rest, `AIComponentSchema` included) stay exported as `@deprecated` `z.never()` schemas that accept nothing. When the names leave the published face is #25912's sunset rule. `zod/README.md` says so.
- **CLI.** `known-schema-types.ts` regenerated with `node scripts/regenerate-known-schema-types.mjs` (the three keys leave).
- **Docs.** `ui/content/docs/plugins/plugin-ai.mdx` and its `meta.json` entry, and the `ui/README.md` row.
- **Records.** Per-package sdui records were retired by #26367; `sdui.manifest.json` is unchanged (plugin-ai registered no public component).
- **Changeset.** `.changeset/25921-retire-plugin-ai.md`: `@object-ui/types`, `@object-ui/i18n`, `@object-ui/cli` minor, BREAKING, one FROM / TO line per retired export, and the ADR-0087 marker `not-required (runtime-export-retired …)` naming the three plugin-ai exports.

**Follow-up, not here (Tier H):** `skills/objectui/guides/project-setup.md` and `skills/objectui/guides/page-builder.md` still name `@object-ui/plugin-ai`. They are governed, so they go in a separate PR after this one.

### Forced test edits (each follows the deletion, none relaxes a check)

- New pin `ui/packages/types/src/__tests__/plugin-ai-retired-25921.test.ts`: compile-time absence from `AnySchema` and the `never` names, the named refusal for each literal with its remedy, a firing control (`button` still accepted), a generic-path control for an unknown literal, and the eight zod names accepting nothing.
- Deleted, because their subject left with the package: `ai-zod-arms-10859.test.ts`, `ai-node-faces-agree-10874.test.ts`, `ai-zero-read-members-retired-8178.test.ts` (they pinned the arms and member tombstones of the three nodes) and the package's own five test files.
- `ai-insights-retired-8800.test.ts`: lit controls re-pointed at what the module still carries (the `never` declarations, the refusal arm).
- `zod-mirror-parity.test.ts`: seven pairs out of `MIRRORS`; the two runtime-slot `KnownDrift` entries out (51 entries / 87 keys, header history sentence added); `EXPECTED_MIRROR_PAIRS` 204 to 197; the eleven new consts in `EXCLUSIONS` with reasons.
- `arm-named-export-8784.test.ts` (three `ABSENT_BY_DECISION` rows), `any-component-emit-headroom-11573.test.ts` (three inline arms replace the category union), `component-docs-retired-handler-keys-7340.test.ts` (31 to 29, `ai.ts` leaves; `onDismiss` becomes unambiguously retired), `content-channel-family-d-9256.test.ts` (the `nl-query` row, 31 to 30), `content-channel-parser-tier-clause-10928.test.ts` (two message sources remain), `silence-clause-parser-tier-closure-10981.test.ts` (non-vacuity probe moves to `views.ts`).
- `ui/packages/cli/src/__tests__/registered-types-validate-ratchet-10859.test.ts`: the "armed" case becomes a by-name refusal case with a generic-path control; the README end-to-end case left with the README. `ui/scripts/markdown-test-inputs.mjs` follows (two entries).
- Counts that follow the deletion, re-measured after merging `main` `d2ca7079`: the license-text floor in `ui/scripts/__tests__/package-files-exist.test.ts` (36), the `files`-entry floor in the same file (150 → 145, 149 measured), and `ui/QUICK_REFERENCE.md` (35 published packages, derived by `quick-reference-commands-4149`). The lockstep count gate was retired by #26511.
- Deletions-only ledgers lose their plugin-ai rows: `clickableNonControlCensus-13461`, `iconOnlyButtonCensus-12143`, `runner-package-test-entry-3746`, `doc-version-claims`; `percent-storage-callers-11475` loses its plugin-ai exclusion set and the case that read it.
- `console-vite-alias-closure-4925.test.ts`: its named negative control was plugin-ai; it is now `@object-ui/cli`, a published library with an `exports` map that the console neither imports nor aliases. `select-type-check-scope.test.ts`: its leaf-package fixture moves to `plugin-markdown` (same closure shape, no fields / dashboard / grid).

## Tests

- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/types packages/i18n packages/cli scripts packages/components/src/__tests__` on the merged tree (after `origin/main` at 222755eb): 935 files, 19817 passed, 3 failed. Two were real counts this PR owed (`package-files-exist` license-text floor, `QUICK_REFERENCE.md` published-package count, both fixed in db6ddb4d); the third (`check-vi-mock-inherit`) was a 15 s timeout under the shared box. The three files rerun alone: 111 / 111 passed.
- Before the merge, the same packages plus the touched component census tests: 517 files, 12560 passed; the six failures that run found were the ledgers listed above, fixed, then 76 / 76 on the three files.
- Ablation of the new pin: `RetiredNLQueryNodeSchema` deleted from `AnyComponentSchema` in `zod/index.zod.ts` (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`) turns exactly the two `nl-query` cases of suite 1 red (2 failed, 15 passed of 17); restored, blob equals HEAD.
- `tsc` type-check of `@object-ui/types`, `@object-ui/i18n` and `@object-ui/cli`: exit 0 (the compile-time pins and the `@ts-expect-error` line included).

## Acceptance notes

- **ADR-0087 gate red, Blocked-by #26220.** `node scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs --base origin/main` exits 1 with three predicate-1 refusals only: the gate maps a published entry through tsup's `dist/index.d.ts` to `src/index.ts`, and plugin-ai's source entry is `src/index.tsx` (vite-plugin-dts). ADR-0087 D9 writes that convention into its text, so the fix is a gate change plus a D9 wording amendment, which the seat has put on #26220. Predicates 2 and 3 have nothing to say once the FROM lines name exactly the three operands. No other category fits on the facts, and the FROM / TO lines are kept.
- **No pending changeset is edited.** The earlier `25831` correction is gone: 18.2.0 consumed that changeset, and main's deletion was accepted on merge.
- **Serial constraints.** Lands after 18.2.0 (published 2026-10-27). It shares `ui/QUICK_REFERENCE.md` and the package-count floors with #26483 (app-shell made private) and #26521 (floors to a shared constant). Whichever lands later merges `main` and re-measures.
- External npm consumers of `@object-ui/plugin-ai`: NOT MEASURED; the changeset carries the FROM / TO lines.
- Unrelated `plugin-ai` mentions under `packages/spec`, `packages/metadata-protocol` and `scripts/check-service-providers.mjs` name the platform's own AI service plugin, not this package, and are untouched.

## Verification

- Premise re-measured with a positive control: 0 `package.json` dependents of `@object-ui/plugin-ai`; `ui/apps/console/src/register-plugins.ts` and `ui/apps/console/vite.config.ts` name it 0 times, against 2 and 4 for `@object-ui/plugin-markdown`; no sdui registry record.
- Build: `turbo run build --filter=@object-ui/console... --filter=@object-ui/cli...` 72 / 72, before and after the merge of `main`.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --ran` at head `bde1e722`: 54 derived, 54 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED. The only red is `check-adr-0087-registration --base origin/main`: predicate 1 ×3, "no workspace manifest at HEAD is named @object-ui/plugin-ai", the whole-package removal the D9 text does not cover yet. `check-empty-changeset` is green. CI on `bde1e722`: 56 complete, 49 success, 6 skipped, 1 failure (Check Changeset, the same refusal).
- `node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs --changed-from origin/main`: 0 anchored files in the change set.
- sdui: no per-package records to re-record (retired by #26367); `sdui.manifest.json` unchanged after the merge.
- Leftover pre-merge notes under `ui/.changeset/` still name `@object-ui/plugin-ai`; the root changesets config does not read that directory (`ui/AGENTS.md`), so they are untouched.
